assertion_analysis.failure_condition: a read-only reclassify pass changes the membership of the out-of-scope slices, which raises SystemExit before the JSON is rewritten; this is the one added condition that refuses.

post_apply_readback.restored_names_still_dropped would be non-empty if the apply failed to bind a planned name; like the pre-apply check it is recorded, not asserted.
